investment_theses.thesis: Long Bitcoin spot + perps; midterm election cycle + institutional ETF accumulation + geopolitical risk premium (Iran, Greenland, China tariffs) drive BTC to $95k-$110k by EOY 2026.
supporting_signals: Spot BTC ETF inflows at 9-month highs ($1B Monday); 52 BTC whitehats evacuation shows exchange risk premium pricing.
Trump approval on economy low; trade deal urgency with Xi is explicit political driver.
Greenland deployment announcement = Cold War 2.0 geopolitical risk-on signal for non-correlated assets like BTC.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed hawkish reversal on rates or U.S.-China trade war escalates into actual tariff shock; liquidity drain in May-June corrects leverage buildup.
investment_theses.expression: BTC spot (direct holdings) + BTC 3-month perps on Deribit/Binance (2-3x leverage, delta hedge with short stablecoins); alternatively, iShares Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) or Grayscale (BTC)
